preconditions: Ready authenticated account; current user_id and account-owned draft/question/media; submit revalidates consent, privacy, balance and blocks.
visible_feedback: Pure navigation has no Loading; selection is transient. Business writes show custom 500ms Loading, lock duplicates, preserve input on failure. Source control/animation retained.
success_result: Same user_id → question_id → draft_id → request_id; only accepting account establishes Connection/Conversation. Navigation returns to actual origin.
failure_result: Readable inline error; no partial request, consent or ledger mutation; cancelled/obsolete work cannot submit.
persistence: Store metadata for saved draft/request; IndexedDB for recorded Blob; browsing/selection/navigation none.
sync_scope: Discover, profile, Home, sent/received, Connection and authorized Conversation; current account only.
acceptance: scripts/discover-request-browser.test.mjs --page=text; corresponding HostTests native pixel/flow test; source/actual/overlay/diff in this folder.
